svg.title: Fourier series
svg.desc: Four circles for the odd harmonics join one at a time, each spinning on the tip of the one before at 1, 3, 5 and 7 times the base rate. A faint line carries the tip's height to a plot on the right, which traces sin t, then sin t + sin 3t / 3, and so on, each sum closer to the square wave drawn faintly behind, while the formula above gains a colored term for every circle.
